title: Coherent depth-two model of a finite locally free module on an affine open
statement:
theorem exists_affine_depth_two_locally_free_model
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing A] (W : (Spec A).Opens)
    (hboundary : ∀ x : Spec A, x ∉ W →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth
        (R := (Spec A).presheaf.stalk x) ((Spec A).presheaf.stalk x))
    (P : W.toScheme.Modules) [P.IsFiniteLocallyFree] :
    ∃ H : (Spec A).Modules,
      H.IsQuasicoherent ∧
      (∀ V : (Spec A).Opens, IsAffineOpen V →
        Module.Finite ((Spec A).presheaf.obj (op V)) (H.val.obj (op V))) ∧
      (∀ x : Spec A, x ∉ W →
        ∃ hfinite : Module.Finite ((Spec A).presheaf.stalk x)
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) H.val.presheaf x),
          letI := hfinite
          (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := (Spec A).presheaf.stalk x)
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) H.val.presheaf x)) ∧
      Nonempty (Modules.restrict H W.ι ≅ P)

proof.text: Use the existing affine locally free model core to obtain a coherent extension H0 of P with finite affine sections. Set M = Gamma(H0,top) via moduleSpecGammaFunctor. Its finiteness over A follows from finite_sections_top_of_finite. The affine counit fromTildeGamma identifies tilde M with H0; restrict this isomorphism and compose with the given restriction isomorphism to P.

Construct D = ModuleCat.of A (Hom_A(Hom_A(M,A),A)) and H = tilde D, with no existence choice. Noetherian finiteness instances prove both duals finite. The tilde global-section isomorphism proves finite global sections of H, hence finite presentation by isFinitePresentation_of_finite. finite_sections_of_isFinitePresentation then gives finite sections on every affine open.

The double-dual restriction lemma preserves the finite locally free restriction P. Apply the corrected boundary property to M, whose actual double-dual sheaf is precisely H. Assemble quasicoherence, finite affine sections, the boundary depth bound, and the restriction isomorphism into the unchanged existence statement.
